alerts.message: Checkpoint 17607 scored 2/64 balanced math and 0/16 easy plus 0/16 hard Sudoku. Complete-answer reasoning remains weak at this early checkpoint.

Learned checkpoint gradients reach the concept core, but removing concept guidance changes NLL by under 0.001 in all four offline batches. Code changes affect logits only weakly; no useful concept contribution established yet.

Live logs contain only dense preclip gradient norm on the last update of each 20-step interval; sparse Engram and per-layer live gradients were never recorded. CPU checkpoint probes are labeled separately.
RBF wiring and frozen-backbone write contracts passed, but retention/transfer gains have not been measured. No RBF writes occur in this pretraining run.

train.loss.*.meaning: Mean of microbatch-normalized losses over the logging interval; not token-weighted across families. Exploration/selector include zero on non-auxiliary updates.

train.gradient.dense_preclip_norm.meaning: Dense parameters only, L2 norm before clipping, measured on the final update of the logging interval. Excludes sparse Engram table; not an interval average.

derived.dense_clip_scale.meaning: Inferred from clip_grad_norm_(max_norm=1); not separately measured.

train.memory.*.meaning: Logged GiB counters; Apple unified-memory counters overlap and must not be summed.

eval.*.cadence: About 30 minutes; small fixed development samples
eval.*.meaning: Per-family NLL, concept ablation, coordinate spread, code counts and strict complete-answer generation; zero-trial accuracy is absent, not zero.

probe.*.meaning: Fresh gradient and ablation probes, labeled by stored checkpoint step. Never historical optimizer-step gradients.

probe_eval.*.meaning: Independent stratified generation evaluation; separate from the trainer small fixed sample.

host.*.meaning: External CPU/RSS/system memory samples, independent from train memory counters.

per_layer_gradient_norms.reason: Not emitted by the running trainer; unavailable historically. Can be measured in explicitly labeled checkpoint probes.

engram_gradient_norm.reason: Trainer checks/clips this norm but does not log it.

gpu_utilization_and_temperature.reason: No reliable public cross-process MPS utilization/temperature source is configured.

rbf_activity.reason: RBF bank is intentionally empty during pretraining; no continual-learning episode has been run in this training run.

checkpoint_step.reason: Collector records checkpoint filesystem metadata without deserializing it; only an explicit checkpoint audit can establish its exact stored step.
